name: BTW Contact Forms
author: boostetonwp

sections.description:
BTW Contact Forms is a plugin that lets you easily create and manage your contact forms (Customer support, quote requests, lead generation, recruitment, appointment scheduling, feedback and reviews, reporting or moderation, partnerships and collaborations, internal support (extranet / intranet)).

No complicated settings, no HTML or CSS code to manage. You simply choose the position and type of fields you want to include in your forms.
That’s it!
They then integrate seamlessly into your theme.

When your customers contact you, you receive an email and a message that can be viewed directly from your site’s administration panel.
No risk of missing a message!

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the btw-contact-forms folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu
  3. Access the settings via the BTW Contact Forms menu
sections.faq:
How do I create my first contact form?

Your first form is already created! You can of course adapt it to your needs, add or remove fields.

Can I customize the fields in the contact form?

Yes. You can change the position of the fields, their types (text, date, time, dropdown list, checkbox, email), make them mandatory or optional and display a placeholder.

Where do the form submissions get sent?

You will receive an email and also a message that can be viewed directly from your WordPress site’s administration panel.

Is the contact form mobile-friendly and responsive?

Yes.

Are the forms protected against spam?

Yes. An anti-bot system is automatically integrated into all your forms to prevent the receipt of unwanted messages.
